passage:
An orchestra streamed its concerts online. People who lived far away or could not afford tickets could listen at home.
Some musicians worried that fewer people would come in person. Instead, online viewers sometimes became future visitors.
The orchestra also added short explanations before pieces so new listeners could understand them better.
Digital access changed the audience. The concert hall became larger than its walls.
However, the conductor said online sound was not the same as feeling music vibrate in a room.
The stream was not a replacement. It was an invitation. Technology can widen the doorway to art.
